title: Configure firstmate as the first study instance in athena.toml
summary: Set athena.toml's [capabilities.study] repo_url to the firstmate GitHub repo and repo_ref to main, so a study job can start. The M1 (work handling) study runs as a separate study job, because that job reads this config from the base commit.

defaults_applied.how: Recovered the repo URL, ref and M1 meaning from BRIEF.md and the commented example in athena.toml instead of asking.
Only the configuration step is done here; the study run is left for its own job.
athena.toml is a governance file, so it is listed as a deliverable and named in a criterion.
Only a public repository URL is committed.

assumptions: 'After that' refers to the study capability build already landed; this job only does the configuration step.

The study itself (M1, work handling) is a separate study-capability job run after this config lands, because a study job refuses to start without repo_url and repo_ref in the base commit's athena.toml.
Pinning main to a commit SHA is done by Athena at dispatch, so the config stores only the ref 'main'.
The URL form is https://github.com/kunchenguid/firstmate (optionally with .git); Athena's loader accepts either.
question: Do you want this job to only configure firstmate in athena.toml, with the M1 study run as a separate job afterward? I assumed yes.

acceptance_criteria.text: athena.toml [capabilities.study] sets repo_url = "https://github.com/kunchenguid/firstmate" (uncommented, replacing the example placeholder) and repo_ref = "main".

No other key in athena.toml changes; the commented example lines are replaced by the real values, with a short comment saying this is the first study instance (BRIEF.md instance A) and that Athena pins the ref to a commit before dispatch.
Run `cargo test` and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`: both pass, so the config still parses and any config-loading tests accept the study repo settings.
No files other than athena.toml (and optionally a CHANGELOG.md line) change; no secrets or personal data are added, and no firstmate content is copied into the repository.

out_of_scope: Running the M1 study of firstmate (a separate study job).
Configuring Hermes Agent or Athena as study instances.
Changing study capability code, skills or the Pages site.
Pinning a commit SHA by hand.
departures: The change is a small config edit, so cost and time are below the reference; the risk is that the request means running the study itself, which lowers acceptance a little.
